title: Higher-Dimensional Schur Trigonometry and the Multigrade Pythagorean Telescoping Chain
description:
We construct the higher-dimensional Schur protractor cos^2Θ + sin^2Θ = 1 on prime Hilbert spaces. We prove that the correlation angle Θ contracts through a multigrade telescoping chain: from the 1D prime plateau of 9.721° (sin^2Θ = 0.028512), Grade-2 semiprimes swing the angle down to 5.651° (sin^2Θ = 0.009695), Grade-3 triples reach 5.411°, Grade-4 reaches 5.409°, and the full cutoff N = 1000 reaches 4.646°. We formalize in Lean 4 the Pythagorean identity, the Weierstrass rational trigonometric half-dimension formula, and the multigrade telescoping chain with zero custom axioms.
